scope: Targeted ordinary-input verification on the exact official browser export: Story missions 01 and 02, one completed Arcade room, menu transitions, ordinary-reload checkpoints and one earned 1.1-to-1.2 save upgrade. This is not a full browser campaign or full Arcade-cycle qualification.

identity.sourceIdentityScope: descriptor, project, assets and plugin contents
identity.browser: Codex in-app browser; browser engine/version not independently recorded

romComparison.scope: This compares the two identified files. It does not transfer native gameplay results into browser execution or establish a clean-clone/cross-machine build result.

campaign.rigScope: Standard for all eight completed M01/M02 rooms. Wide Coil selected for the M03 launch/menu checks; no M03 room completion is claimed.
campaign.routeScope: M01 route selection and reload recovery were exercised; not every mission/order/rig combination was replayed.

missions.name: BULKHEAD CIRCUIT
missions.recovery: Returned to Title and used Continue; guardian checkpoint restored at H3. Three subsequent hits and completed mission were observed at H3.

arcade.recovery: Normal fresh retry after the initial S01 failure.
arcade.rigScope: Opened optional Change Rig, then Back; rig remained unchanged.
arcade.storyCheckpointAfterBankAndReload: Continue M03 remained available and restored Debris Halo, Bay 1/4, H3.

saveChecks.name: Earned 1.1 checkpoint upgraded at the same origin
saveChecks.method: Earned M01 launch checkpoint in frozen 1.1 using ordinary input. Ordinary reload and Continue restored it. Replaced only the served ROM with exact 1.2, then ordinary reload and Continue restored the same checkpoint.
saveChecks.limit: One earned launch checkpoint on the same browser/origin; no native save-file association or cross-device migration claim.

saveChecks.method: Ordinary page reload showed a fresh title; Continue restored the completed mission card.

saveChecks.name: Arcade bank preserves Story Continue
saveChecks.method: Banked 300, then ordinary page reload showed Best Banked 00300 and Continue M03. Continue restored the saved M03 launch briefing.

menuChecks.name: Direct launch with held A plus Right
menuChecks.observed: M03 launched and movement occurred without an unintended pulse; subsequent HUD showed A Ready.

menuChecks.name: Pause objective reminder and Retry
menuChecks.observed: Pause menu shown; Retry returned to the Debris Halo Ready to Fly briefing at H3.

menuChecks.name: Select/Pause exit confirmation and cancel
menuChecks.observed: Exit actions showed Exit This Run and Checkpoint Retained; cancellation was exercised.

menuChecks.name: Optional Arcade rig picker and Back
menuChecks.observed: Change Rig opened the picker; Back returned without changing the current rig.

method.controls: Ordinary CUA keyboard inputs selected and observed by the testing agent. No game-state, heap, browser-storage or snapshot writes were used to grant progress.
method.persistence: Ordinary page reload creates a fresh official emulator from browser-stored SRAM. This test origin has no full-state recovery wrapper.
method.saveDataHandling: Browser storage and raw save contents were not directly read or written by the testing agent. The game/runtime performed its normal checkpoint persistence.
method.inputRecordCompleteness: The retained helper log is partial: manual input bursts are not all logged. The receipt is not a complete deterministic replay trace. Screenshots establish sampled displayed states; reload, retry, held-input and intervening gameplay claims also rely on the recorded operator observations.
method.imageReview: The testing agent reviewed every screenshot using derived contact sheets. Additional review checked the selected guardian-hit, banking, reload and mislabeled-menu originals. Original screenshots remain unchanged.

consoleObservation.result: No error or warning entries returned by the final bounded tab.dev.logs query.
consoleObservation.scope: Final browser-tab observation reported by the testing agent; not a complete continuous console transcript or a statement about compiler warnings.

evidence.localEvidence: The full screenshot inventory, partial input helper log, build/upgrade receipts and local paths remain in the private local verification archive.

historicalVersion1_1.scope: Preserved unchanged historical 1.1 full-browser campaign receipt. Its 42:41 result does not qualify 1.2.
